speaker: R
text: Our class hamster escapes his locked cage every Friday without opening the door.

speaker: R
text: Maya has the spare key, so I taped the door shut.

speaker: R
text: I watched her all morning, but Sir Nibbles still vanished.

speaker: R
text: All Maya did was wash his food drawer.

speaker: R
text: We clean his cage every Friday and Monday, with our backpacks lined up beside it.

speaker: R
text: And by Monday's first lesson, he's always back inside.

speaker: R
text: I checked for bite marks and gaps between the bars.

speaker: R
text: Then I found sunflower shells inside my backpack.

speaker: R
text: And at home, my hamster Peanut kept building a second nest.

speaker: R
text: So the next Friday, I filmed the cage during cleanup.

speaker: R
text: At home, I set my backpack next to Peanut's cage.

speaker: R
text: At midnight, something scratched inside it.

speaker: R
text: He'd crawled out through the food drawer hole, straight into my backpack.

speaker: R
text: I was his weekend ride to Peanut, and Monday's cleanup was his ride back.

speaker: R
text: Now I park his getaway car right beside the cage.
